title: Austin Live Music Crawl
includes: Live entertainment - see authentic live music at different Austin venues
Transportation in a Mercedes Sprinter van
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please arrive 15 minutes prior to start time
Please check in with the Austin Detours tour guide by 7:45 pm outside the Driskill Hotel (604 Brazos St, Austin, TX 78701)
Due to vendor regulations, pets and emotional support animals are generally NOT permitted. Guests with a service dog MUST contact the local tour operator in advance to request approval.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
With over 250 live music venues, Austin is known as the Live Music Capital of the World! Many of these venues are located outside of downtown and tucked into neighborhoods, so come explore with a true Austin local as we show you some of Austin’s best spots. Have fun jamming out to authentic live music all over the city!

Check out live music shows at 3 (three) different venues. Entry fees/cover charges included. All performances and venues are authentically Austin, but will vary in genre, size, style and neighborhood.
